reference_targets_freetext.item: Calf circumference asymmetry >3 cm (10 cm below tibial tuberosity)
reference_targets_freetext.rationale: Objective asymmetry is the most reproducible Wells criterion for DVT

reference_targets_freetext.item: Wells DVT items on history and exam: bedridden >3 days, active cancer, prior VTE, recent surgery, pitting edema confined to the symptomatic leg, collateral superficial veins
reference_targets_freetext.rationale: One structured pretest-probability instrument; determines whether ultrasound can wait until morning

reference_targets_freetext.item: Ask about pleuritic chest pain, dyspnea, or presyncope
reference_targets_freetext.rationale: Screens for concurrent pulmonary embolism, which changes urgency

reference_targets_freetext.item: Inspect for well-demarcated erythema, warmth, lymphangitic streaking, and a portal of entry
reference_targets_freetext.rationale: Cellulitis signs (one construct) are the main mimic of DVT in a unilateral swollen leg

reference_targets_freetext.item: Tenderness along the deep venous course and a palpable superficial cord
reference_targets_freetext.rationale: Localizes thrombus and supports proximal extension

off_bedside_acceptable: checking whether pharmacologic VTE prophylaxis was ordered and given
should_not_recommend: Homan's sign as a rule-in or rule-out test
Empiric therapeutic anticoagulation without examining the leg or estimating pretest probability
Withholding the leg examination because an ultrasound is ordered for the morning
